name: WithdrawalRateMath
summary: FIRE withdrawal-rate math for Swift: sequence-of-returns survival, guardrail cuts, and the inflation-adjusted floor.
description:
Swift math for judging a withdrawal rate per scenario instead of on
average: the inflation-adjusted floor each retirement year has to
cover, which return sequences actually deplete the portfolio and when,
the guardrail cut that keeps a plan alive, the runway the remaining
balance buys, and the savings needed to reach a target balance at a
real return. Pure Foundation, no dependencies, Decimal throughout so
plan-level audits never inherit floating-point drift. Built by the
Firenomics team, which publishes withdrawal-rate and sequence-risk
math for early retirees.
